name: Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology
summary: SCTIMST is an Institute of National Importance under the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India, combining a hospital wing with biomedical technology and public health research. Its hospital offers cardiovascular and neurological care services.
highlights: Origin traced to a 1973 gift of a building by the Travancore royal family
Sree Chitra Tirunal Medical Centre inaugurated in 1976
Declared an Institute of National Importance by an Act of Parliament in 1980
Hospital Wing, Biomedical Technology Wing and Achutha Menon Centre for Health Science Studies
